Callout.Name: Withdrawal
Callout.Message: Person shaking and vomiting, withdrawing from something.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, no injuries, refuses to say what.
Callout.Patient: I just need to get through it. I have done it before.

Lines.Approach: Shaking, sick, and not saying what he has been taking. Keep your kit close.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
